detailed_description:
The target video uses a live-action cinematic style with soft golden-hour sunset lighting, a warm slightly desaturated color palette, and 35mm lens depth of field.
[Shot 1] A medium-wide shot establishes <Subject 4>, the rooftop open-air café with light wooden deck, rattan chairs, white umbrellas, the right-side bar with warm string lights, and the distant city skyline. <Subject 1>, the young woman with center-parted straight black hair, freckles, navy knit vest over white shirt, and blue plaid skirt, sits screen-left in a rattan chair facing right, both hands resting on the table. <Subject 2>, the young woman with voluminous wavy black hair, beige-and-blue striped sweater, and black shorts, sits screen-right facing left. The camera holds a static shot as <Subject 1> (S1), in a soft friendly young female voice, says with a gentle smile, <d>[Chinese] 好久不见，你最近怎么样啊？</d> She tilts her head slightly while <Subject 2> listens attentively.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the shot cuts to an over-the-shoulder medium close-up from behind <Subject 1>'s left shoulder, framing <Subject 2> screen-right. <Subject 2> leans forward, eyes widening with excitement, her right hand raised in an expressive gesture. In an energetic young female voice, <Subject 2> (S2) says enthusiastically, <d>[Chinese] 我跟你说，我最近遇到一件超级离谱的事！</d> Her mouth opens wide on the emphasized word. <Subject 1>'s shoulder and the back of her head remain in soft focus in the left foreground. The city skyline blurs in the background behind <Subject 2>.
[Shot 3] At 00:05.500, the shot cuts back to a medium shot of the table. <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> remain seated in their established screen-left and screen-right positions, still facing each other. From the right side of the frame, <Subject 3>, the waitress with a brown single braid, pink shirt, and grey apron, walks in carrying <Subject 5>, the white latte cup on a light-wood tray with a silver spoon, held with both hands at chest level. She approaches the table with a polite smile. The warm bar lights glow behind her.
[Shot 4] At 00:08.000, the shot cuts to a slightly high-angle medium close-up of the table. <Subject 3> stands screen-right, leaning forward and using both hands to lift the white latte cup from the wooden tray and place it gently on the table directly in front of <Subject 1>, with the cup handle turned toward her. The silver spoon remains on the tray in <Subject 3>'s hands. <Subject 1>, seated screen-left, looks up at <Subject 3> with a warm appreciative expression, her lips parting to speak. <Subject 2> watches from the right background.
[Shot 5] At 00:10.500, the shot cuts to a medium shot. <Subject 1> sits screen-left, turned slightly toward <Subject 3>, smiling and raising her right hand in a small wave. In a polite grateful young female voice, <Subject 1> (S1) says, <d>[Chinese] 谢谢。</d> <Subject 3> stands center-right, her hands now empty at her sides, smiling brightly and nodding slightly. In a cheerful service-industry young female voice, <Subject 3> (S3) replies, <d>[Chinese] 不客气，慢用。</d> <Subject 2> sits screen-right, smiling at the exchange. The white latte cup rests on the table in front of <Subject 1>.
[Shot 6] At 00:13.000, the shot cuts to a medium-wide shot. <Subject 3> walks away toward the right-side bar with her back to the camera, her brown braid visible, exiting the main interaction area. <Subject 1> sits screen-left, both hands wrapping around the warm white latte cup and bringing it close to her nose, eyes closing briefly as she savors the aroma with a satisfied smile. <Subject 2> sits screen-right, leaning forward and continuing to talk animatedly, her right hand gesturing. The camera holds a static shot as the warm sunset light bathes the rooftop café and city skyline, settling into a calm, cozy final frame.

overall_soundscape:
Soft rooftop café ambience continues throughout, with distant city traffic hum, a gentle warm breeze, and faint clinking from the bar area. Light footsteps on the wooden deck mark the waitress's approach and departure. The ceramic cup makes a soft clink as it is set on the wooden table, followed by the faint rustle of fabric as the girls shift in their chairs.
